name: Tail of the Dragon (two-way)
description:
Deals Gap or Tail of the Dragon - 11 miles and 318 curves, is America’s most thrilling destination for motorcycle riders and sports car enthusiasts.

Winding along US 129 where the Great Smoky Mountains meet the Cherokee National Forest, this iconic stretch offers a pure driving experience: no intersections—just you and the road.

What makes the Tail of the Dragon legendary isn’t just the technical challenge—it’s the rugged beauty, the rush of adrenaline, and the shared respect among those bold enough to conquer it.
author: Project Kaido
